$comment: Which App Review gate device families the macOS image the reviewer-path
legs run on has a simulator for. The gate's plan job reads it on Linux
(.github/scripts/ios_review_gate_devices.py plan), so a family the image
has no simulator for never queues for a Mac: its skip marker comes from
the plan instead. It applies only while scripts/ci/xcode-pins.txt names
`xcode` for `macos`; after a pin bump the plan walks every family and the
legs' own picker decides, as before, until this file is checked again.
Every leg the plan sends to a Mac checks this list against the image
(the same picker, app_review_pick_simulator.py, with no simulator
created); a family the image has and the list says it lacks, or the
Only duo may be absent: the report requires iphone and ipad.

measurement.method: Each job selected Xcode 27.2 build 27B48. The gate picker found iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch (M5); the duo picker returned its no-compatible-simulator result. These observations precede XCTest execution.

duo.reason: the gate picker found no compatible iPhone Duo simulator on the macOS 26 image with Xcode 27.2 (run 46073620005)
